name: Ukraine
overview: Scripture connects Ukraine to the descendants of Japheth, including Tubal and Javan, highlighting its place among the nations known in biblical history. God’s sovereign call to Abram to leave his country points to His guidance over peoples and lands, while Isaiah’s prophecy mentions Tubal and Javan as recipients of those who will declare God's glory among the Gentiles. This reveals God's purpose to use all nations, including those linked to Ukraine, to proclaim His fame. The call to be peacemakers, as taught by Christ, reminds believers to seek God's peace amid the nations.
